text: Testing is a crucial part of software development. It ensures that code works as expected and helps catch problems early. There are different levels of testing. Unit tests check small, individual parts of the code, like a single function. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write the test first, watch it fail, and then write the code to make it pass. This approach helps clarify what the code should do and leads to cleaner design. Ultimately, a strong testing strategy gives developers and teams confidence to make changes, fix bugs, and add new features without constantly worrying about breaking something.
